![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The import `com.google.cloud.gcs.analyticscore.client.HermeticGcsFileSystem` is redundant because `com.google.cloud.gcs.analyticscore.client.*` is already imported on the previous line. Additionally, the repository style guide discourages wildcard imports (see Section 4, 'Java Imports'). Consider removing this redundant import, or ideally, expanding the wildcard import into explicit imports.

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Never use wildcard imports. Limit static imports to well-known, self-describing methods/constants from standard libraries. Keep imports sorted per Google Style. <sup>([link](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/gcs-analytics-core/blob/main/.gemini/styleguide.md))</sup>
</details>
